# netactuate_server (Resource)

Manages a Server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_server" "example" {
  hostname = "example.netactuate.local"
  plan     = "vc-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hostname` (String) Hostname assigned to the server.
- `plan` (String) Plan name accepted by the API.

### Optional

- `allow_downsize_reboot` (Boolean) Single opt-in for disruptive scaling. Defaults to false: in-place upgrades that need no reboot happen automatically, but any scale that DOWNSIZES (reduces mem/cpu/disk) or otherwise requires a REBOOT is rejected during terraform apply before the scale API call instead of silently downsizing/rebooting a running server (a downsize always reboots on this platform). Set true to permit downsize+reboot. This guards against an out-of-band portal scale-up being silently reverted.
- `cloud_config` (String) Value sent to the NetActuate API for this field.
- `cloud_pool_id` (Number) Cloud pool ID
- `image` (String) Value sent to the NetActuate API for this field.
- `image_id` (Number) Value sent to the NetActuate API for this field.
- `location` (String) Value sent to the NetActuate API for this field.
- `location_id` (Number) Value sent to the NetActuate API for this field.
- `package_billing` (String) Not recoverable on import: the API's server-read endpoint has no field reflecting the current billing mode, so this stays at its default ("usage") after `terraform import` regardless of the live server's actual billing configuration.
- `package_billing_contract_id` (String) Value sent to the NetActuate API for this field.
- `package_billing_opt_in` (String) Value sent to the NetActuate API for this field.
- `params` (String) Additional JSON formatted parameters to be passed to the server creation and management API
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Not recoverable on import: the API has no endpoint that returns which credential was used to build a server, so this stays unset after `terraform import` regardless of the live server's actual configuration. Set it explicitly after import if you intend Terraform to manage it.
- `ssh_key` (String) Not recoverable on import: the API has no endpoint that returns which credential was used to build a server, so this stays unset after `terraform import` regardless of the live server's actual configuration. Set it explicitly after import if you intend Terraform to manage it.
- `ssh_key_id` (Number) Not recoverable on import: the API has no endpoint that returns which SSH key is associated with a server, so this stays unset after `terraform import` regardless of the live server's actual configuration. Set it explicitly after import if you intend Terraform to manage it.
- `tags` (String) Tag name or comma-separated tag names to associate with the server, e.g. "kube" or "kube, sjc, cluster". Tags are created automatically if they do not exist. When configured, Terraform is authoritative and forces the portal/API tag set to match this value. When omitted, the server's tags are left unmanaged.
- `user_data` (String) Value sent to the NetActuate API for this field.
- `user_data_base64` (String) Value sent to the NetActuate API for this field.
- `vpc_id` (Number) VPC ID to deploy the server into

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `primary_ipv4` (String) Value returned by the NetActuate API for this field.
- `primary_ipv6` (String) Value returned by the NetActuate API for this field.
- `private_ip` (String) Alias for vpc_reserved_network for easier private IP discovery.
- `vpc_reserved_network` (String) The private IP address reserved for this server within its VPC.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_server.example 12345
```
